public_render_sha256.algorithm: sha256(normalized six-field row joined by newline in declared field order)

source_supported_fact.es: El magistrado López Villarrubia firmó actos de apertura y decisiones posteriores sobre alegaciones de obras, acceso, inspección, pericial, conservación y liquidación en Concurso 36/2012; LPB era la única concursada.
source_supported_fact.en: Magistrate López Villarrubia signed the opening act and later decisions addressing works, access, inspection, expert, conservation and liquidation allegations in Insolvency 36/2012; LPB alone was the debtor.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Fija actor, capacidad, fechas y aviso documentado de alegaciones concretas en actos firmados; permite comprobar si la supervisión dejó un déficit probatorio material.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It fixes actor, capacity, dates and documented notice of specific allegations in signed acts, and permits testing whether supervision left a material evidential deficit.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Una hipótesis de prevaricación u omisión exige resolución o deber exacto, adopción personal, injusticia objetiva o manifiesta, elemento subjetivo histórico aplicable, capacidad y causalidad.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: A judicial misconduct or omission theory requires an exact decision or duty, personal adoption, objective or manifest injustice, the historically applicable mental element, capacity and causation.

strongest_counterevidence.es: La suspensión de 26-jun-2018, la negativa de convalidación de 24-oct-2019, la conservación de la legitimación de Aweswell, la corrección parcial de motivación, los Autos motivados, la función conservativa de la AC y las vías de recurso son la contraprueba judicial más fuerte.
strongest_counterevidence.en: The 26-Jun-2018 suspension, 24-Oct-2019 refusal of convalidation, preservation of Aweswell's standing, partial correction of deficient reasoning, reasoned orders, the administrator's conservation role and remedial routes are the strongest judicial counterrecord.

falsification_production_target.es: Expediente certificado completo y matriz acto–petición–prueba disponible–conocimiento–deber–recurso–resultado.
falsification_production_target.en: Complete certified file and an act–request–available evidence–knowledge–duty–appeal–result matrix.

title.es: Masa activa, unidad productiva e inspección neutral
title.en: Active estate, productive unit and neutral inspection

source_supported_fact.es: La arquitectura de liquidación distinguió bienes LPB y ajenos y contempló publicidad/mejora; los Autos de 2020/2021 registran alegaciones de demolición, acceso y obras, rechazan inspección/pericial y remiten conservación a la AC.
source_supported_fact.en: The liquidation architecture distinguished LPB assets from third-party assets and contemplated publicity/improvement; the 2020/2021 orders record demolition, access and works allegations, refuse inspection/expert evidence and place conservation with the administrator.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Permite investigar si la falta de línea base finca–foto–daño–valor afectó conservación, valoración, competencia y recuperación de la capa operativa.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It supports investigating whether the missing property–photo–damage–value baseline affected conservation, valuation, competition and recovery of the operating layer.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: La ineficacia o el error no equivalen a delito; una omisión penal necesita deber concreto, conocimiento, capacidad real, equivalencia causal y dolo cuando proceda.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Ineffectiveness or error is not crime; a criminal omission needs a concrete duty, knowledge, practical capacity, causal equivalence and intent where required.

strongest_counterevidence.es: La suspensión de 26-jun-2018, la negativa de convalidación de 24-oct-2019, la conservación de la legitimación de Aweswell, la corrección parcial de motivación, la titularidad mixta, la competencia conservativa de la AC y las vías de recurso son la contraprueba judicial más fuerte.
strongest_counterevidence.en: The 26-Jun-2018 suspension, 24-Oct-2019 refusal of convalidation, preservation of Aweswell's standing, partial correction of deficient reasoning, mixed ownership, the administrator's conservation role and remedial routes are the strongest judicial counterrecord.

falsification_production_target.es: Mapa finca–interior–propietario–obra–daño–valor; solicitudes y respuestas de AC; pericial; cuentas; activos, contratos, ingresos y goodwill de la unidad productiva.
falsification_production_target.en: Property–interior–owner–works–damage–value map; administrator requests/responses; expert evidence; accounts; and productive-unit assets, contracts, income and goodwill.

title.es: Control material y exclusión de 7 de junio

source_supported_fact.es: El registro preserva una operación material disputada de control/exclusión y una cadena de autoridad incompleta; los carriles de Comunidad, AC y CAM siguen separados.
source_supported_fact.en: The record preserves a disputed material control/exclusion operation and an incomplete authority chain; Community, administrator and CAM lanes remain separate.

supported_investigative_inference.es: La restricción o pérdida de acceso y capacidad operativa alegada y documentada por fuentes de distinto rango puede ser un puente causal hacia obras, asimetría informativa, desactivación del rescate y comercialización posterior.
supported_investigative_inference.en: The restriction or loss of access and operating capacity alleged and recorded by sources of differing rank may be a causal bridge to works, information asymmetry, rescue disablement and later marketing.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Debe identificarse quién ordenó, autorizó, ejecutó, conoció o ratificó cada acto y quién tenía un deber jurídico concreto y capacidad real para impedirlo, con autoridad, dolo, beneficio y perjuicio propios.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: The inquiry must identify who ordered, authorised, carried out, knew or ratified each act and who had a concrete legal duty and practical capacity to prevent it, with actor-specific authority, intent, benefit and harm.

strongest_counterevidence.es: Existen explicaciones de seguridad, conservación y gestión limitada; el archivo penal provisional y el Auto 804/2018 son material procesal adverso. El expediente no prueba una orden directa concreta ni un propósito criminal común.
strongest_counterevidence.en: Security, conservation and limited-management explanations exist; the provisional criminal archive and Order 804/2018 are adverse procedural material. The record does not prove a specific direct instruction or common criminal purpose.

falsification_production_target.es: Órdenes, contratos de seguridad, comunicaciones, registros de acceso, llaves, inventarios, autoridad de Comunidad/CEXP/AC y trazado persona–acto–hora.
falsification_production_target.en: Instructions, security contracts, communications, access logs, keys, inventories, Community/CEXP/administrator authority and a person–act–time trace.

source_supported_fact.es: El tercer postor no compareció, no estaba personado y no depositó fianza; se aprobó la propuesta de CAM. Título, crédito, compensación, valor, pago y contabilidad son funciones distintas.
source_supported_fact.en: The third bidder did not attend, was not personated and lodged no bond; CAM's proposal was approved. Title, credit, set-off, value, payment and accounting are distinct functions.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Es un nodo procesal documentado en el camino hacia la adjudicación; permite comprobar si el déficit previo de acceso, información o valoración condicionó la competencia y el resultado.
supported_investigative_inference.en: This is a documented procedural node on the path toward adjudication; it permits testing whether earlier access, information or valuation deficits conditioned competition and result.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Fraude procesal requiere engaño concreto, autor, conocimiento, uso, error judicial, disposición, beneficio y perjuicio; la atribución judicial exige sus elementos separados.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Procedural fraud requires a specific deception, author, knowledge, use, judicial error, disposition, benefit and harm; judicial attribution requires its separate elements.

strongest_counterevidence.es: Incumplimiento documentado del postor, condiciones competitivas aprobadas y actos protectores/suspensivos previos pueden sostener una explicación procesal lícita.
strongest_counterevidence.en: The bidder's documented default, approved competitive conditions and earlier protective/suspensive acts may support a lawful procedural explanation.

falsification_production_target.es: Acta/grabación, oferta y fianza, anexos de activos, crédito–valor–pago–compensación–remanente, escritura, Registro de la Propiedad y asientos contables.
falsification_production_target.en: Hearing record, bid and bond, asset annexes, credit–value–payment–set-off–surplus ledger, deed, Land Registry and accounting entries.

title.es: Club Sei: proyecto y comercialización antes del título
title.en: Club Sei: project and marketing before title

source_supported_fact.es: Fuentes públicas y de proveedores apoyan preparación, piloto y presentación pre-título de Club Sei en la dirección de Sun Park; la persona jurídica, contrato, autoridad, reservas e ingresos exactos no están identificados.
source_supported_fact.en: Public and supplier sources support pre-title Club Sei preparation, pilot work and presentation at the Sun Park address; the exact legal person, contract, authority, bookings and revenue are not identified.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Permite probar o refutar si un actor del perímetro Meeting Point/FTI obtuvo autoridad, información, oportunidad comercial, beneficio o custodia vinculados al activo antes del título.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It permits proving or disproving whether a Meeting Point/FTI-perimeter actor obtained authority, information, commercial opportunity, benefit or custody linked to the asset before title.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Cualquier explotación no autorizada, fraude o lesión concursal exige persona jurídica exacta, acto, autoridad, conocimiento, dolo, ingreso/beneficio y pérdida de masa o tercero.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Any unauthorised exploitation, fraud or estate-injury theory requires the exact legal person, act, authority, knowledge, intent, revenue/benefit and estate or third-party loss.

strongest_counterevidence.es: Aplazamiento COVID; marketing y pilotos no prueban apertura, reservas, ingresos, autoridad de todo el hotel, contrato ni delito.
strongest_counterevidence.en: COVID postponement; marketing and pilots do not prove opening, bookings, revenue, whole-hotel authority, contract or crime.

falsification_production_target.es: Persona jurídica/NIF, contratos, inventario de habitaciones/fincas, autoridad, PMS/OTA, reservas, facturas, comisiones, pagos y comunicaciones con CAM/AC.
falsification_production_target.en: Legal person/NIF, contracts, room/property inventory, authority, PMS/OTA, bookings, invoices, commissions, payments and CAM/administrator communications.

title.es: SEPI/FASEE: crédito público, revelación y pérdida
title.en: SEPI/FASEE: public credit, disclosure and loss

source_supported_fact.es: SEPI documenta EUR 31m para Meeting Point: EUR 20,7m participativo y EUR 10,3m ordinario; las cuentas FASEE aportan asignaciones por entidad.
source_supported_fact.en: SEPI documents EUR 31m for Meeting Point: EUR 20.7m participating and EUR 10.3m ordinary; FASEE accounts provide entity allocations.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Si existían derechos, riesgos o contingencias materiales Sun Park/Club Sei, nace una prueba de revelación, seguimiento, custodia y posible impacto de crédito público.
supported_investigative_inference.en: If material Sun Park/Club Sei rights, risks or contingencies existed, a disclosure, monitoring, custody and possible public-credit impact test arises.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Falsedad, omisión o uso indebido requieren declarante/obligado, deber, materialidad, conocimiento, confianza, aplicación de fondos y pérdida cuantificada; no es automáticamente fraude de subvenciones.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Falsehood, omission or misuse require a declarant/obligor, duty, materiality, knowledge, reliance, use of funds and quantified loss; this is not automatically subsidy fraud.

strongest_counterevidence.es: No hay trazado actual a Sun Park, omisión probada, deterioro, perjuicio ni deber personal judicial de aviso a SEPI.
strongest_counterevidence.en: There is no current tracing into Sun Park, proved omission, impairment, harm or personal judicial duty to notify SEPI.

falsification_production_target.es: Instrumentos, garantías, origen/uso, disclosures, seguimiento, repagos, intereses, exposición y deterioro; expedientes del deudor, SEPI y Auren.
falsification_production_target.en: Instruments, security, source/use, disclosures, monitoring, repayments, interest, exposure and impairment; debtor, SEPI and Auren files.

title.es: Meeting Point 357/2024: atribución, reparto y archivo Auren
title.en: Meeting Point 357/2024: attribution, allocation and Auren file

source_supported_fact.es: Los controles de fuente del repositorio registran tres copias archivadas de anuncios de 24-oct que atribuyen la prórroga al Magistrado-Juez López Villarrubia; Auto 97/2025 firmado por Guillermo Fernández García acredita tres deudores, cronología 23/31-jul, petición Auren 23-ene y nombramiento 18-feb.
source_supported_fact.en: Repository source controls record three archived copies of 24-Oct notices attributing the extension to Magistrate-Judge López Villarrubia; Auto 97/2025 signed by Guillermo Fernández García establishes three debtors, the 23/31-Jul chronology, 23-Jan Auren request and 18-Feb appointment.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Activa producción seria sobre firma, reparto, conocimiento, posible causa del art. 219 y contenido/custodia de 357/Auren; no cierra ninguna de esas proposiciones.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It triggers serious production on signature, allocation, knowledge, any Article 219 ground and 357/Auren content/custody; it closes none of those propositions.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: CP 446 exige adopción personal, injusticia objetiva/manifiesta, conocimiento o dolo y causalidad; CP 447 exige, según la norma temporal aplicable, imprudencia grave o ignorancia inexcusable. El art. 219 es una prueba procesal separada, no delito por sí mismo. Una teoría de ocultación exige delito y deber exactos, actor, dato conocido, omisión material, elemento subjetivo y efecto.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: CP 446 requires personal adoption, objective/manifest injustice, knowledge or intent and causation; CP 447 requires, under the applicable historical text, gross negligence or inexcusable ignorance. Article 219 is a separate procedural test, not itself an offence. A concealment theory requires an exact offence and duty, actor, known fact, material omission, mental element and effect.

strongest_counterevidence.es: Sustitución ordinaria, refuerzo, reasignación, corrección o error registral podrían explicar los nombres; no se ha probado una causa legal de abstención.
strongest_counterevidence.en: Ordinary substitution, support, reassignment, correction or registry error could explain the names; no statutory recusal ground is proved.

falsification_production_target.es: Originales 18-sep/24-oct, metadatos, reparto/sustitución/refuerzo/corrección, abstención/recusación/revelación, comunicación completa y anexos, mandato, conflicto, solicitudes, recibos, informes y papeles Auren.
falsification_production_target.en: 18-Sep/24-Oct originals, metadata, allocation/substitution/support/correction, abstention/recusal/disclosure, complete communication and annexes, and Auren mandate, conflict check, requests, receipts, reports and workpapers.

title.es: Salida financiada ONA y contrafactual competitivo
title.en: ONA funded exit and competitive counterfactual

source_supported_fact.es: El expediente documenta una arquitectura propuesta de salida financiada ONA–Clubotel–Aweswell/LPB, con actores profesionales y sujeta a condiciones, garantías, aprobación y desembolso aún incompletos.
source_supported_fact.en: The record documents a proposed ONA–Clubotel–Aweswell/LPB funded-exit architecture with professional actors, subject to still-incomplete conditions, security, approval and drawdown.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Proporciona un contrafactual para medir si control/exclusión, pérdida operativa y decisiones posteriores impidieron una arquitectura financiada que habría debido superar sus condiciones, y si afectaron valor o competencia.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It provides a counterfactual for measuring whether control/exclusion, operating loss and later decisions prevented a proposed financed architecture that still had to satisfy its conditions, and whether value or competition was affected.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: El fracaso de una negociación no prueba interferencia criminal; exige condiciones cumplibles, autoridad, conocimiento, acto causal, finalidad, beneficio y pérdida cuantificada.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Failure of a negotiation does not prove criminal interference; it requires feasible conditions, authority, knowledge, a causal act, purpose, benefit and quantified loss.

strongest_counterevidence.es: Faltan cierre, garantía y condiciones completas; la operación podía fracasar por razones comerciales o jurídicas independientes.
strongest_counterevidence.en: Closing, security and complete conditions are missing; the transaction could have failed for independent commercial or legal reasons.

falsification_production_target.es: Term sheet, financiación, garantías, autorizaciones, condiciones precedentes, cronología de cierre/ruptura y comunicaciones con AC, tribunal, acreedores y postores.
falsification_production_target.en: Term sheet, financing, security, authority, conditions precedent, closing/break chronology and communications with administrator, court, creditors and bidders.

title.es: Resultado observable, beneficio, perjuicio y respuesta institucional
title.en: Observable result, benefit, harm and institutional response

source_supported_fact.es: La transacción notarial de 2022 y los registros oficiales de apoyo público y estados procesales son observables en carriles jurídicos separados. No están acreditados aquí el título beneficiario actual exacto, el operador jurídico actual, la cuantía o destinatario de ingresos ni las distribuciones.
source_supported_fact.en: The 2022 notarial transaction and official public-support and procedural-state records are observable in separate legal lanes. This module does not establish exact current beneficial title, the current legal operator, income amount or recipient, or distributions.

supported_investigative_inference.es: Permite reconstruir hacia atrás quién se benefició, qué activo/derecho cambió, qué registro debía existir y qué causalidad o pérdida puede medirse; no convierte el resultado en prueba retroactiva de delito.
supported_investigative_inference.en: It permits backward reconstruction of who benefited, what asset/right changed, what record should exist and what causation or loss can be measured; it does not turn the result into retrospective proof of crime.

criminal_first_element_gate.es: Debe probarse delito por delito y actor por actor: acto/omisión, deber/autoridad, conocimiento/dolo, nexo, beneficio, perjudicado, cuantía y ausencia de doble recuperación.
criminal_first_element_gate.en: Proof must remain offence-by-offence and actor-by-actor: act/omission, duty/authority, knowledge/intent, nexus, benefit, injured party, quantum and no double recovery.

strongest_counterevidence.es: La adjudicación pudo ser lícita; el incumplimiento documentado del postor, las decisiones motivadas y la falta de puentes documentales siguen siendo explicaciones y límites reales.
strongest_counterevidence.en: The adjudication may have been lawful; the bidder's documented default, reasoned decisions and missing documentary bridges remain real explanations and limits.

falsification_production_target.es: Cadena de título/beneficiario, capex, ingresos, financiación, distribuciones, reclamante–finca–pérdida–remedio, decisiones institucionales completas y contrafactual de valor.
falsification_production_target.en: Title/beneficial-owner chain, capex, income, financing, distributions, claimant–property–loss–remedy ledger, complete institutional decisions and value counterfactual.

edges.forward_inference: Did documented notice of the stated allegations and the chosen evidential measures affect preservation and valuation?
edges.reverse_falsification: Would the complete estate and inspection record show effective protection or no causal effect?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The suspension, refusal of convalidation, reasoned later orders, administrator conservation role and available remedies support a lawful-supervision explanation.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the certified docket and a dated act-request-evidence-knowledge-duty-remedy-result matrix, including every inspection and conservation request and response.

edges.forward_inference: Did unresolved ownership, access and conservation conditions enable the disputed control change?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do authority, access and inventory records establish a limited lawful operation with no estate displacement?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: Mixed ownership, the administrator's conservation competence, security explanations and the adverse provisional criminal archive may explain the control measures without estate displacement.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the property-by-property ownership and inventory baseline, administrator authority, security mandate, access logs, keys record and person-act-time chronology.

edges.forward_inference: Did control/exclusion interrupt the proposed funded-exit route, and could that route have satisfied its outstanding conditions?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do finance and condition-precedent records show the proposed route independently could not have completed?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: No closing, security perfection, satisfied conditions precedent or drawdown is established; independent commercial or legal failure remains a complete alternative explanation.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the term sheet, committed-funds proof, security package, conditions-precedent ledger, authority approvals and event-level closing or break chronology.

edges.forward_inference: Did any neutral-evidence deficit materially condition bidding or valuation?
edges.reverse_falsification: Would the complete bid and valuation file show equal information and no outcome effect?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The approved competitive conditions, the third bidder's non-appearance and missing bond, and the absence of a bidder inspection request may explain the result without a valuation distortion.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the complete valuation and bidder data rooms, access parity record, inspection requests, asset schedules, all bids and bonds, hearing record and valuation-to-result comparison.

edges.forward_inference: Did material control supply access, information or opportunity for Club Sei?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do contracts, access records and supplier files show independent lawful authority and no use of disputed assets?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: Security or limited-management explanations, COVID postponement, and the absence of proved bookings, revenue or a whole-site operating contract may sever the alleged bridge.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce dated access and key records, the exact Club Sei legal entity and NIF, supplier instructions, property and room schedules, authority contracts, PMS or OTA records, invoices and payments.

edges.forward_inference: Did any proved pre-title Club Sei access, information, commercial positioning or benefit materially condition competition or adjudication?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do dated contracts, property schedules, title and bid records eliminate the alleged pre-title causal bridge or show no outcome effect?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: Public presentation and pilot work do not establish operation, bookings, revenue, bidder advantage or influence on the adjudication; documented bidder default offers an independent explanation.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the dated Club Sei contract-authority-revenue file alongside the title, property schedule, bidder information sets, bids, bonds and decision record to test temporal and outcome causation.

edges.forward_inference: Were material Club Sei/Sun Park rights, risks or contingencies relevant to FASEE disclosure or monitoring?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do loan and disclosure files show no relevant item, no duty or full disclosure?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The current record neither identifies a debtor-owned Club Sei right nor proves a disclosure duty, omission, reliance, impairment or public loss.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce entity-specific FASEE applications, representations, security and monitoring files together with Sun Park or Club Sei contracts, rights, risks, contingencies and source-and-use records.

edges.forward_inference: Did any exact 357 debtor hold a Club Sei/Sun Park contract, asset, claim, contingency or record?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do complete debtor schedules and Auren workpapers show no such connection or responsibility?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The exact contracting entity remains unidentified, and neither public marketing nor the three-debtor proceeding proves that any debtor owned a Club Sei or Sun Park asset, claim or liability.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce each debtor's complete asset, contract, claim and contingency schedules, intercompany records, Club Sei entity documents and the corresponding Auren intake and verification workpapers.

edges.forward_inference: Was the 24-Oct attribution a signed act, substitution, support, reassignment, correction or registry error, and what knowledge was material?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do the original and allocation records establish ordinary assignment, no Article 219 ground and no relevant cross-file knowledge?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: Ordinary substitution, support, reassignment, correction or registry error remain open, and the controlled record proves neither a signed 24 October act nor an Article 219 conflict ground.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the signed 18 September and 24 October originals, Public Insolvency Register metadata and custody, reparto and substitution records, and any abstention, recusal or disclosure file.

edges.forward_inference: How were FASEE claims, conditions, security and disclosures treated in 357/2024?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do the complete communication and SEPI file show accurate treatment and no creditor/public loss?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The official EUR 31 million support record and the later three-debtor proceeding do not by themselves establish inaccurate treatment, omitted security, reliance, impairment or loss.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the complete 357/2024 communication and annexes, creditor and security schedules, Auren workfile, SEPI monitoring and repayment files, and final restructuring treatment by exact debtor.

edges.forward_inference: Did any proven omission or conflict affect creditor or public-funds outcomes?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do final restructuring, monitoring and outcome records show no material omission, reliance or loss?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: No omission, statutory conflict, institutional reliance, altered restructuring result, creditor shortfall or public-funds loss is presently established.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce final restructuring decisions and creditor outcomes, SEPI exposure and recovery records, any conflict decision, counterfactual treatment and claimant-specific quantum analysis.

edges.forward_inference: What benefit, estate loss and claimant-specific damage followed from adjudication and later operation?
edges.reverse_falsification: Does the title, payment, capex, income and distribution ledger support lawful value and no recoverable loss?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: The adjudication may have been lawful, the bidder default is documented, and the current record does not establish current beneficial ownership, income recipients, distributions or recoverable loss.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the deed and registration chain, credit-value-payment-set-off-surplus accounting, beneficial ownership, capex, operator, income and distribution ledgers, and claimant-by-claimant loss analysis.

edges.forward_inference: Did any proved control or exclusion materially condition access, information, valuation, rescue capacity, bidding or adjudication?
edges.reverse_falsification: Do complete access, valuation, rescue and bid records show equal conditions, no displacement and no outcome effect?
edges.strongest_contrary_evidence: Security and conservation explanations, adverse procedural material, approved competitive conditions and the third bidder's default may independently account for the events and result.
edges.confirm_or_falsify_production: Produce the complete access, authority, rescue, valuation and bidder-information chronology, all bids and bonds, hearing record and a counterfactual test of outcome with and without the alleged exclusion.

boundaries: The matrix is an investigative inference graph, not a judicial or criminal finding.
Every forward inference is paired with a reverse falsification route and the strongest lawful or innocent explanation.
Economic unity does not merge legal persons, titles, debts, estates, acts, knowledge, intent or liability.
A later benefit or current operation does not retroactively prove an earlier offence.
No current evidence establishes knowing judicial injustice, an improper relationship, a statutory Article 219 ground or a personal judicial duty to notify SEPI.

For AM357-N07, public Git preserves aggregate source controls but not the signed Auto 97/2025 binary or a reproducible per-copy full-hash custody manifest for the three notices; do not claim public-binary integrity closure.
The ONA relationship to the 7 June event is carried as a separate attributed/counterfactual lane in AM357-N08 and edge AM357-E03, not as an affirmative AM357-N03 fact.
Daily Decanato reference no. 24 is a presentation locator, not a formal NIG or proceeding.
